The monitoring system tracks operational health dynamically based on ticket lifecycle state transitions.
Multi-Ticket Edge Case: If multiple active tickets are attached to one asset, status remains RED until all linked tickets reach Resolved or Closed status.
Trigger Event: Support Ticket Created & Asset Tagged.
Trigger Event: Ticket Resolution / Closure.
Impacted State (RED)
• Technician links Asset_Tag (e.g., ST001PC01) to active ticket.
• System executes DB hook: Set Asset.Health = 'RED'.
• Store Monitoring Dashboard re-renders item badge to RED.
Operational Recovery (GREEN)
• Technician marks ticket as Resolved or Closed.
• System validates 0 remaining open tickets for this asset tag.
• System updates DB Set Asset.Health = 'GREEN'.
